title: Number of Vape-related Arrests Made, and Update on Enforcement, Preventive and Rehabilitative Measures for Tackling Vaping
what_it_is: Number of Vape-related Arrests Made, and Update on Enforcement, Preventive and Rehabilitative Measures for Tackling Vaping

sections.label: E-vaporiser enforcement and penalties
sections.summary: HSA detected almost 10,000 possession or use cases and 38 supply cases of e-vaporisers in eight months, with over half of users under 25.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In the first eight months of this year, the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) detected almost 10,000 cases of possession or use and 38 cases of supply of e-vaporisers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Amongst users, more than half are under 25 years old.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: This was in fact one of the key considerations when we banned the supply and use of e-vaporisers years ago, and our fears have unfortunately come true.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: This year, HSA detected 70 cases of possession or use of etomidate e-vaporisers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: With e-vaporisers, the landscape of substance abuse has changed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We launched a whole-of-Government response, which we announced on 28 August 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Over 2,800 online advertisements, including those found on messaging platforms, were removed between January and August this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Platforms have a legal responsibility to detect and remove advertisements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Those with inadequate processes will face penalties, including fines and imprisonment, under the Tobacco (Control of Advertisements and Sale) Act.

sections.label: Etomidate as Class C drug
sections.summary: Etomidate is to be listed as a Class C Controlled Drug under the Misuse of Drugs Act.

sentences.text: Third, listing of etomidate as a Class C Controlled Drug under the Misuse of Drugs Act, or MDA.

sections.label: HSA hotline and online reports
sections.summary: HSA received over 4,600 hotline reports and over 1,400 online form reports between January and August.

sentences.text: HSA received over 4,600 hotline reports between January and August, and over 1,400 reports through the new online form launched on 21 July.

sections.label: E-vaporisers and components collected
sections.summary: About 6,000 e-vaporisers and components were collected between July and August.

sentences.text: About 6,000 e-vaporisers and components were collected between July and August.

sections.label: Sign-ups for programmes
sections.summary: From 1 September to 14 September, 74 persons signed up for these programmes.

sentences.text: From 1 September to 14 September, 74 persons have signed up for these programmes.

sections.label: New e-vaporiser legislation planned
sections.summary: New legislation will provide enforcement powers, mandatory rehabilitation and supervision regimes, and penalties, planned for enactment in the first quarter of 2026.

sentences.text: The new legislation will provide legal powers to enforce against e-vaporisers of all kinds, provide for mandatory rehabilitation and supervision regimes, and set appropriate penalties for users and suppliers.
We plan to enact the new legislation in the first quarter of 2026, to continue to support this whole-Of-Government approach to protect Singaporeans from the harmful effects caused by e-vaporisers.

sections.label: Underground activity and tough laws
sections.summary: MHA will take very tough actions against things that go underground, with its tough laws.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Things do go underground and MHA, with our tough laws, will take very tough actions against them.

sections.label: Etomidate enforcement and Class C listing
sections.summary: Multiple agencies are empowered against etomidate offences; etomidate was listed as a Class C drug in MDA, with new legislation planned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Today, SPF, HSA, ICA, CNB, the National Environment Agency, Land Transport Authority, MOE, Gambling Regulatory Authority, all the officers are empowered now to take actions against etomidate related offences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As the Member mentioned, there were instances in the past, because etomidate fell between the legal cracks, which is why there was a point that the SPF did not feel they were empowered to enforce; yet, it falls under HSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But HSA finds that our penalties, if we catch someone possessing or using etomidate, the penalties are not stringent enough, which is why we took the step of listing etomidate as a Class C drug in MDA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As I mentioned, early next year, we want to pass new legislation to make the necessary provision to enforce against this.

sections.label: Case fell through transition period
sections.summary: The Member wrote about a case that fell through the cracks during the transition period; listing etomidate in MDA closes the loophole.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The Member wrote to me about this case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: This is one of those cases that fell through the cracks during that transition period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Right now, with etomidate listed in MDA, we close the loophole.

sections.label: Student etomidate rehabilitation and school discipline
sections.summary: Students caught using etomidate through e-vaporisers must undergo rehabilitation and face MOE school discipline; etomidate derivatives are listed under MDA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If a student is caught using etomidate through e-vaporisers, he will be required to go through the rehabilitation programme, either at IMH or one of our SSA partners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: On top of that, MOE will, through their own in-house school discipline system, impose other punishments, such as suspension.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: For precursors, I assume you meant the derivatives of etomidate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: They are all listed as part of the Class C drug under MDA, they have already been listed.

sections.label: Adult drug prevalence survey result
sections.summary: The latest survey showed prevalence among adults aged 15 and above is 8.8%, a historical low and one of the lowest worldwide.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The latest survey showed that prevalence among adults – "adults" meaning aged 15 and above – is 8.8%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It is a historical low and one of the lowest in the world.
